en: The Philippine eagle, the national bird, is a critically endangered raptor endemic to the forests of Mindanao and Luzon.
Ambrosio Rianzares Bautista read the Philippine Declaration of Independence on June 12, 1898, in Kawit, Cavite.
The Philippine Congress consists of two chambers: the Senate with twenty-four members and the House of Representatives.
National hero Jose Rizal wrote the novels Noli Me Tangere and El Filibusterismo to expose Spanish colonial abuses.
The Ifugao people built the Banaue Rice Terraces over two thousand years ago using stone walls and mud.
The Sinulog festival in Cebu City honors the Santo Niño through a rhythmic two-step forward and backward dance.
Filipino, the national language, is primarily based on Tagalog and incorporates words from various other Philippine languages.
Doctor Fe del Mundo was the first Asian admitted to Harvard Medical School and invented a low-cost bamboo incubator.
The Filipino value of bayanihan is traditionally demonstrated when neighbors carry a nipa hut to a new location.
The Philippines is divided into seventeen administrative regions, including the Cordillera Administrative Region and the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region.
The sampaguita, a fragrant white jasmine, was declared the national flower of the Philippines in 1934.
Filipino citizens must be at least eighteen years old and registered to vote in national and local elections.
